reuse.why: All month-wide actions reuse shouldBudgetCategory, and the new action reuses averageToBudgetAmount, getSheetValue, batching, and undo registration.

duplication.why: Five actions repeat the same category query, joins, eligibility projections, and result type instead of sharing their retrieval.

placement.why: Eligibility policy remains in month-budget-categories.ts, database access and orchestration remain in actions.ts, and method registration remains in app.ts.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their shared policy, registration, and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: Centralized eligibility and amount conversion help maintenance, but repeated query definitions and the now-unused action parameter leave unnecessary coordination and interface clutter.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every affected month-wide action calls shouldBudgetCategory, and setLastMonthSpending uses the existing amount conversion helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category queries in setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, and set12MonthAvg are direct duplication rather than disguised implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldBudgetCategory gains includeHiddenCategories and retains the obsolete action parameter; all callers continue using the helper without adding action-specific branches.
